fit: Fit signed eight causal score features to observed home/away point counts. IID binomial and match-latent Beta-binomial likelihood use complete stopped-score counts; scoring-path factors independent of fitted parameters omitted. Penalized mean negative log likelihood, not fabricated probabilities. All parameters fit strictly before calibration cutoff.
calibration: Choose rally-logit temperature and one shared shrink-to-causal-league weight on prior calibration only, pooled 14-target Brier. Shared mixture preserves cross-market coherence. Poisson benchmark uses only three declared match-total thresholds, no winner/set probability borrowed.
projection: Exact IID set endpoint kernels to 11/win-by-two with analytic infinite deuce tail. Saturated total-point convolution at 86 preserves exact probabilities for the declared totals <=84.5. Point-margin convolution and stopped BO5 set-score paths share the same process. Beta-binomial integrates point probability uncertainty by Gauss-Jacobi quadrature. Prediction grid interpolation is deterministic, not Monte Carlo forecasts.
scope: Exploratory replay of previously inspected archive. Same 1804 outer-fold cases when eligible. Report proper probability scores and paired 3-day-block uncertainty with multiplicity correction; no independent validation or automatic model promotion. New 64-case diagnostic and prospective v9/v10 cohorts are not used for fitting, calibration, or model selection in this experiment.
limitations: Only BO5 complete reported set scores; no point-by-point sequence, first server, serve/receive probabilities or verified live state
IID conditionally on a latent match point probability; no claim to capture tactical changes or true momentum
Poisson count benchmark does not represent a complete legal score process and is limited to match totals
No ROI or executable price backtest; no new operational opportunities or random forecasts from an unvalidated projection
poissonFeatures: Absolute eight signed causal strength features plus mean of players last-30 total-point and total-set context (x39/x47 and x38/x46). Standardized on training only. Poisson total prediction conditioned on complete BO5 T>=33; approximate count benchmark, not a full score model.
